record.what_it_does: Monday.com is a Work OS / project-management platform where teams manage boards, items, and workflows, accessible programmatically via a GraphQL platform API.
record.auth_notes: Personal API tokens (sent as a raw value in the Authorization header, not a standard 'Bearer <token>' scheme) authenticate as a single user with that user's own permissions - fine for single-tenant scripts but not for a multi-user agent toolkit. Third-party apps distributed across multiple accounts use OAuth2 (legacy flow with non-expiring access tokens and no refresh tokens, or a newer OAuth 2.1 flow with expiring/refresh tokens) via a free app created in the Developer Center.
record.access_notes: Any developer can sign up for a free, non-expiring developer/sandbox account and immediately obtain a personal API token from the Developer Center; creating an OAuth app (client_id/client_secret) is also free and self-serve, no approval step required to obtain working credentials.

evidence.quote: The monday.com platform API utilizes personal V2 API tokens to authenticate requests
OAuth 2.0 is a protocol that lets your app request authorization to read or modify data in a user's monday account
Create a free developer account and start building right away
GraphQL APIs use a single endpoint for all operations (unlike REST APIs). Our API endpoint is: `https://api.monday.com/v2`
Connect using the hosted MCP, which requires no local setup
Our webhook integration provides real-time updates from monday.com boards
